# External skills

Pre-made skills I find useful and install as-is. This is a list, not a mirror: the skills themselves stay in their source repositories, so they are never copied or edited here.

A skill I start modifying no longer belongs in this list. Move it to [`../skills/`](../skills/) and credit the original in a `CREDITS.md`.
